title: Kaplan Fibres
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Short deep fibres that tie the iliotibial band to the femur, described in 1958, forgotten, and now the reason the band restrains rotation at all.
Conventional teaching places the proximal attachment about 50 mm above the lateral epicondyle and the distal one about 30 mm above it, both close to the supracondylar ridge.
